description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A maxillofacial surgeon needs a 3D model of the skull with the lower anterior teeth digitally extracted to plan for immediate dentures. Perform the following steps: (1) Create a segmentation mask using the 'Bone' preset (226-3071 HU). (2) Use the 'Manual Edition' tools (Eraser) to carefully remove the lower incisors and canines (approx. 6 front teeth) from the mask, leaving the mandibular bone intact. (3) Generate a 3D surface from this modified mask. (4) Position the 3D view to show the front of the mandible clearly and export a screenshot to /home/ga/Documents/edentulous_view.png. (5) Export the modified 3D surface as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/edentulous_skull.stl.
